quarterly_data.quarter: MasTec press release: MasTec to Acquire The Superior Group, Enhancing MasTec's (07-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MasTec agreed to acquire The Superior Group, a full-service electrical contractor with approximately 3,000 employees that is a recognized leader in building data center infrastructure; Superior extends MasTec inside the fence (electrical systems, integrated building systems, facility services) and will be reported in the Power Delivery segment. Superior is projected to generate full year 2026 revenue of approximately $1.6 billion to $1.7 billion; MasTec expects Superior to contribute revenue of $800 million-$900 million for the remainder of 2026 and $2.2 billion-$2.5 billion in 2027. Closing anticipated mid to late July 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Superior FY2026 revenue ~$1.6-$1.7 billion; contribution $800-$900 million rest of 2026, $2.2-$2.5 billion in 2027
